# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Refer to the water-distribution system map and the inspection records to identify the following in order to create a list of the properties which may have been exposed to the failed water quality:
   - Date/time samples were collected
   - Location of the samples (GPS coordinates)
   - Service lines connected to the failed samples
   - Other service lines with similar conditions at the time (ex: under construction 40 feet away, or were connected to a main that has experienced recent mainbreaks or major flushing)
   - Time of the day and day of the week patterns and relationships
   - Water ages
   - Determine the index of connectedness. Connection can include any of the following: geographical proximity, pressure zones, age of service laterals (likely to have similar conditions if installed at the same time), chlorination levels, etc.
